_about: Scoring table for cuore/services/common_cause.py and cuore/services/suspect_ranking.py. Every value is a heuristic weight chosen by the CUORE maintainers, NOT a measured probability. Points add up to a qualitative band (High / Medium / Low); CUORE never converts them to percentages. Edit a value and the next page load uses it (caches key on this file's mtime).

max_set_size.why: A cause set larger than 3 'explains' almost anything, so it stops being a diagnosis.

max_sets.why: Keeps the page readable; the count found is still reported.

max_partial.why: Single causes that explain only some of the faults, best first.

stale_code_days.why: A code not seen for two weeks and not in open work is history, not a current fault.

symptom_days.why: A reported symptom older than a month is treated as no longer current unless the owner re-reports it.

specificity_element.why: A named wire, fuse, ground, connector or module is something a mechanic can go and test.

specificity_system.why: A whole system (e.g. electrical supply) is a hint, not a place to put a meter.

role_supply.why: Supply, fuse, ground and connector hops are shared upstream causes of many faults.

role_controller.why: A controller usually reports a fault rather than causing it, so it ranks below what feeds it when coverage ties.

role_other.why: Sensors, valves and lines are specific parts but usually explain few faults.

tsb_strong.why: A bulletin that explains this car's codes and scores 5+ in the TSB cross-reference.

tsb_moderate.why: A bulletin scoring 3-4: same system or partial code match.

tsb_weak.why: A bulletin scoring 1-2: only loosely related.

tsb_not_the_fix.why: The bulletin's remedy was already done on this car and the code came back.

tsb_ruled_out.why: An inspection recorded on a job says the bulletin's condition was ruled out.

case_fix_worked.why: A prior case on this model lists a matching fix under 'fixes that worked'.

case_hyp_confirmed.why: A prior case on this model confirmed a matching hypothesis.

case_fix_did_not.why: A prior case lists a matching fix under 'did not work'.

case_hyp_refuted.why: A prior case on this model refuted a matching hypothesis.

case_synthetic_factor.why: A case built from logs rather than a closed real job counts half.

job_status_confirmed.why: The mechanic confirmed this hypothesis on the job (it had to pass the confirm gate).

job_status_supported.why: The mechanic marked this hypothesis supported.

job_evidence_for_cap.why: Many 'for' items are not four times as good as one; cap the total.

job_evidence_against_cap.why: Same cap on the refuting side.

job_evidence_against_mult.why: A refuting reading counts more than a supporting one (one counter-example beats several confirmations).

repair_did_not_resolve.why: A repair on this suspect was recorded and a related code was seen again afterwards.

cc_explains_all.why: The shared-cause finder says one cause explains every covered fault.

cc_explains_majority.why: It explains at least half of the covered faults.

cc_explains_some.why: It explains two or more faults.

inspection_bad.why: A recorded inspection of this part found loose / chafed / corroded / water / not found.

inspection_ok.why: A recorded inspection of this part found it OK.

fuse_health_bad.why: CUORE's fuse health marks this fuse orange or red.

measurement.why: A measured number is the strongest evidence.

freeze_frame.why: Conditions when a code set: context, not proof.

code.why: A code is a symptom of the fault, not the fault.

observation.why: An observation made by the mechanic or CUORE.

bulletin.why: A bulletin cited as evidence; its own weight is counted under tsb_*.

high_min.why: Points at or above this read as High.

medium_min.why: Points at or above this read as Medium; below it Low.

High.why: Relative weight of a High suspect when asking how well a test splits the field.

Medium.why: Relative weight of a Medium suspect.

Low.why: Relative weight of a Low suspect.

top_suspects.why: Tests are judged against the top suspects only.

effort_floor_min.why: Set-up overhead added to every test's minutes so a 0 or 2 minute test does not win on tiny differences.

unknown_effort_min.why: A test whose duration CUORE does not know is ranked as if it took this long, and is labelled 'effort unknown'.

ground.why: The test catalogue files voltage-drop tests under this label.

fuse.why: Fuses are checked with the same voltage-drop test.

supply.why: Supply feeds are checked with the same voltage-drop test.

connector.why: A connector is checked for voltage drop across its pins.

battery.why: The battery tests in the catalogue use these labels.

module.why: A gateway or module that drops off the bus is tested as a network fault.

ground.why: Grounds belong to the electrical supply system.

fuse.why: Fuses belong to the electrical supply system.

supply.why: Supply feeds belong to the electrical supply system.

connector.why: Connector pins carry supply and ground.

fuel_smell.why: A fuel smell points at the fuel and vapour systems.

hard_to_refuel.why: A nozzle that keeps clicking off points at the vapour path.

mil_on.why: A lit MIL is an engine-management report.

rough_idle.why: Idle quality is engine management and ignition.

hesitation.why: Hesitation is fuel and engine management.

loss_of_power.why: Power loss is fuel, air and engine management.
